Statistical hypothesis test.

Answers one question about the data on the device (as Data Studio > Explore > Tests): two groups, paired columns, several groups, one column vs a value, or two categories. Its output is one row: the test, statistic, df, p, the estimate and its CI, the effect size, the rows used and whether it is significant, with the answer in words.

| | |

| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Test | Question | `question` | Choice | `two_groups` | `two_groups`, `paired`, `several_groups`, `one_value`, `two_categories` | The run | What to test. |
| Columns | Values | `values` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | The number column (paired: the first one) |
| Columns | Split by | `groups` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | The column that splits the rows into groups (two categories: the rows) |
| Columns | Second column | `second` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Paired or two columns: the second number column; two categories: the columns. |
| Columns | Two columns | `two_columns` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Two groups given as two number columns instead of a group column. |
| Test | Variances | `variances` | Choice | `unequal` | `unequal`, `equal` | The run | Welch (unequal) or Student / classic (equal) |
| Test | Alpha | `alpha` | Number | `0.05` | `0.001-0.5` | The run | Significance level; the CI is at 1 - alpha. |
| Test | Compared with | `value` | Number | `0` |   | The run | One column vs a value: the value the mean is compared with. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
